user.title: Terrarium
user.description: Enclosures, terrariums, light, rain, ventilation, groups and templates are managed in the Terrarium panel. All settings are stored in MariaDB (local copy as fallback).

data_description.db_url: Empty = store locally only. External server: mysql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST/terrarium?charset=utf8mb4 – MariaDB add-on: mysql://USER:PASSWORD@core-mariadb/terrarium?charset=utf8mb4

error.db_url_invalid: Invalid address – it must start with mysql://.
error.db_connect: Cannot connect to the database (check address, user, password, privileges).
